# Vendored HTMX

`htmx-2.0.10.min.js` is the pinned production build from the official `htmx.org` npm
package, version 2.0.10. It is served locally so the shared shell works without a CDN or
internet connection.

- Package artifact: `https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.10/dist/htmx.min.js`
- Upstream source tag: `https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/tree/v2.0.10`
- Artifact SHA-256: `71ea67185bfa8c98c39d31717c6fce5d852370fcdfd129db4543774d3145c0de`
- Licence: Zero-Clause BSD, copied verbatim from the upstream `v2.0.10` tag into
  `HTMX-LICENSE.txt`

Do not replace this file with a floating CDN URL. An upgrade must pin a reviewed version,
refresh the licence if needed, update the checksum above, and rerun the shared frontend tests.
